note: Official publisher template locations. These pages sit behind interactive interstitials, so the files are downloaded in a browser and imported with fetch_journal_templates.py --from-dir. sha256 is recorded on first import and checked afterwards.

templates.file: Nature Portfolio manuscript template (.docx); download from the formatting guide or the journal's submission page
templates.note: Word template. If the journal no longer ships one, the generated template (make_journal_template.py) encodes the same page setup, type and section order.

templates.file: Nature / Nature Portfolio LaTeX template (.zip, from Overleaf: Menu > Download source)
templates.note: Overleaf gallery template; download the source archive while signed in.

templates.file: Science manuscript Word template (.docx), linked from the instructions page
templates.note: AAAS Word template for Research Articles; the page is behind a bot challenge, so download it in a browser.

templates.file: Science LaTeX package (.zip), linked from the LaTeX instructions page
templates.note: AAAS LaTeX style and sample document.
